title: In Search of Prey
description: While exploring the Amazon rainforest near Puyo, Ecuador, this lynx spider caught photographer Dara Ojo's eye. Its long, spiny legs feature bristles that help trap the prey they grasp—a detail that Ojo captured through macro photography. "Every creature has something interesting about it, and sometimes all it takes is getting close enough to appreciate it," he tells National Geographic.
translated_description: 在厄瓜多尔普约附近探索亚马孙雨林时，这只猞猁蛛吸引了摄影师达拉·奥霍的目光。它那长而多刺的腿上长有刚毛，有助于困住它们抓到的猎物——这是奥霍通过微距摄影捕捉到的细节。“每种生物都有其有趣之处，有时只需要足够靠近就能欣赏到，”他告诉《国家地理》。
